title: Statistics
comingSoon: The statistics panel lands in a later phase.
subtitle: How your memory is actually doing — the six measurements that say whether the scheduler is working.

empty.title: Nothing to measure yet
empty.body: Review some cards and these six panels fill in. True retention needs reviews on cards you had already learned, so the first useful numbers appear a few days in.

trueRetention.title: True retention
trueRetention.help: How often you recall a card you were due to recall: the first review of the day, on cards in review with an interval of a day or more.
trueRetention.none: No reviews in this window yet.

byLevel.title: Desired vs true retention
byLevel.help: What each importance level asks of the scheduler, against what you actually recall. A gap over 5 points means it is time to re-optimize or move the target.
byLevel.alert: {count, plural, one {# level is more than 5 points off target} other {# levels are more than 5 points off target}}.
byLevel.none: Not enough reviews this month to compare.

meanRetention.title: Mean retention today
meanRetention.help: Averaged over every card in review, most of which are not due — this sits well above your target retention, and should.
meanRetention.cards: {count, plural, one {# card in review} other {# cards in review}}

memorized.title: Memorized knowledge
memorized.help: The sum of your recall probabilities: roughly how many things you could retrieve right now.

distribution.title: Stability and difficulty
distribution.help: Stability is the interval at which recall falls to 90 %. The share above a year is the share you would still know a year from now untouched.
distribution.none: No card has a measured stability yet.

forecast.title: Forecast
forecast.help: Reviews already scheduled for the next 30 days. New cards are not counted — the reviews they will generate are the simulator's job.
forecast.backlog: {count, plural, one {# card overdue} other {# cards overdue}}
